name: hamster
description: Orchestrates Hamster Studio brief execution with team personas, parallel wave execution, and deep review modes. Ask Hamster, plus setup, ship, plan, resume, review, QA, and retro.

interface.shortDescription: The spec layer for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Hamster is an AI-native product planning workspace where humans and AI teammates share context, align on briefs, and ship together. Write briefs that decompose into spec-driven tasks Codex can execute asynchronously, producing review-ready PRs. The Hamster CLI syncs briefs, tasks, and plans into .hamster/ as markdown files in real time. The plugin supplies Ask and Ship, plus setup, plan-hamster, resume-hamster, review-hamster, qa, and retro. Ask Hamster reads briefs, tasks, plans, documents, notes, initiatives, goals, members, and knowledge-graph context over the Hamster CLI, and over the hosted Hamster MCP server at https://tryhamster.com/mcp in clients that have those tools. In ChatGPT, Hamster works through the hosted MCP server; the setup, ship, plan, resume, review, QA, and retro skills need Codex, because they run the Hamster CLI and git in your repository.
